map.逐个录入各项独立不确定度分量（如仪器、环境、方法），工具按均方根法（RSS）合成: Enter each independent uncertainty component (instrument, environment, method) one by one, and the tool combines them by root-sum-square (RSS) into the combined standard uncertainty, optionally multiplying by a coverage factor for the expanded uncertainty used in test report error statements.

map.按 GUM 法把多个独立不确定度分量（如量具、环境、方法）方和根合成，得到测量结: Combine several independent uncertainty components (gauge, environment, method) by root-sum-square per GUM to get the total standard uncertainty u_c of the measurement result.
map.校准/检测报告给出扩展不确定度前，先评估各分量贡献，识别主导误差来源。: Before issuing extended uncertainty in a calibration or test report, assess each component's contribution and identify the dominant error source.
map.判断现有测量系统是否满足『十分之一』工程准则（测量不确定度 ≤ 公差的 1/10: Judge whether the current measurement system meets the "one-tenth" engineering rule (measurement uncertainty <= 1/10 of the tolerance).
map.：合成标准不确定度 u_c = √(u₁² + u₂² + u₃² + …)，假: : combined standard uncertainty u_c = sqrt(u1^2 + u2^2 + u3^2 + ...), assuming the components are mutually independent; if correlated, add covariance terms. Components can come from gauge resolution, repeatability, temperature/environment, standard transfer and so on. Expanded uncertainty U = k x u_c (k is usually 2, about 95% confidence).
map.：某尺寸测量含三项标准不确定度分量：量具重复性 u₁=0.5、环境温漂 u₂=0: : a dimension measurement has three standard uncertainty components: gauge repeatability u1 = 0.5, environmental thermal drift u2 = 0.3, gauge block transfer u3 = 0.2 (in um): u_c = sqrt(0.5^2 + 0.3^2 + 0.2^2) = sqrt(0.25 + 0.09 + 0.04) = sqrt(0.38), about 0.6164 um. Repeatability (0.5) is the dominant component, so improving the gauge pays more than suppressing thermal drift.
map.为什么用平方和根而不是直接相加？: Why root-sum-square instead of adding directly?
map.各分量属不同来源的随机/系统误差，最坏情况相加（线性叠加）会严重高估；方和根（R: Components come from independent random/systematic errors of different sources; worst-case addition (linear stacking) badly overestimates, while root-sum-square (RSS) gives a statistically sound combined value under the independence assumption and is the internationally accepted GUM approach.
map.分量不独立时怎么处理？: What if the components are not independent?
map.若存在相关性（如同一温度同时影响量具与工件），应在平方和内加入协方差项 2·ρ·: If correlation exists (for instance the same temperature affects both gauge and workpiece), add the covariance term 2 x rho x ui x uj to the sum of squares; for simplicity, first de-correlate or adopt a more conservative correlation assumption to avoid understating the total uncertainty.
